name: 0codekit
description: 0codekit is a versatile platform designed to streamline the development process by providing a suite of tools for coding, debugging, and deployment. Ideal for developers seeking efficiency and precision in their projects.

events.d: Insert one or more pages into an existing PDF file.
Extract age, job title, company, and other custom fields from any text.
Find closest matches for a query in a list using AI.
Redact names, addresses, and other confidential data in a PDF and return a redacted file or URL.
Blur an image from a URL or image data and set blur strength.
Calculate a person's BMI, BMI classification, ideal body weight, daily calorie needs, and nutrient recommendations.
Calculate distance and estimated travel duration between two locations using driving, walking, bicycling, or transit.
Run Python code asynchronously and deliver the result to a webhook URL.
Check if text is appropriate and safe to post
Check if a request is allowed by a named traffic light and minimum time interval.
Compare two strings and get a similarity score and distance.
Reduce the size of a PDF file by optimizing its images and internal structure. The compressed PDF can be returned as a downloadable URL or as a file.
Convert a CSV string into an array of rows for further processing
